verdict.rationale: Polar documents recurring subscriptions with automatic renewal, plan upgrades/downgrades with immediate rate changes, configurable proration behavior (org-level or per-call), trials are implied via subscription lifecycle, and dunning/failed-payment retry schedules; seat-based proration is also documented. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of trial period configuration (only inferred, not directly cited) and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
